people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus, our Lord, from the dead,
translations.bsb: but also for us, to whom righteousness will be credited—for us who believe in Him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.
translations.kjv: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
translations.asv: but for our sake also, unto whom it shall be reckoned, who believe on him that raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,
